title: Squarewise Error Lifecycle History
description: Authoritative schema tracking deprecation dates, sunset policies, and migration replacements for all error codes.

code.description: Six-digit machine code or legacy code identifier.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the error code.

introducedIn.description: Milestone, release version, or task ID when the code was introduced.

deprecatedIn.description: Milestone or release version when the code was deprecated.

retiredIn.description: Milestone or release version when the code was retired.

sunsetDate.description: ISO 8601 date when support for this code is permanently removed.

replacedBy.description: Six-digit replacement code if deprecated or retired.

rationale.description: Justification for deprecation, retirement, or status transition.

migrationGuidance.description: Guidance for API callers or internal systems migrating from this code.
